title: strategy to increase visits indonesia’s five super priority destination
core_idea: This study examines how e-WOM, cultural events, destination image, nationalism, and government support influence tourists' intention to visit Indonesia's five designated super-priority destinations (Toba, Likupang, Mandalika, Borobudur, Labuan Bajo) using a quantitative questionnaire survey of 200 respondents, aiming to inform marketing, destination management, and government strategies to diversify and increase tourism beyond Bali.
tldr: Investigate how e-WOM, cultural events, destination image, nationalism, and government support affect intention to visit Indonesia's five priority destinations to guide strategies for increasing and spreading tourist visits.
